Property Tax Payment Options
After searching for your property above, you can pay your property taxes using any of these methods:
• Online: Credit/Debit Card or E-Check
• In Person: 20 2nd St. SE, Ortonville, MN 56278 | Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM
• Mail: Big Stone County Auditor, 20 2nd St. SE, Ortonville, MN 56278
• Phone: Call (320) 487-1200 for payment by phone
